# Iberian kingdoms: Leon and Portugal choose their crowns, and Galicia
# can break from whoever holds it (the 910 partition). No MTTH emergence,
# no rebels: land conditions plus a player/AI choice, one effect each.
namespace = iberian_kingdoms

# Leon crowns itself: Asturias holding Leon moves the seat and takes the
# lion banner (Alfonso's line rules on either side of the change).
country_event = {
	id = kar_leon.1
	title = kar_leon_1_title
	desc = kar_leon_1_desc
	picture = THRONE_ROOM_eventPicture

	trigger = {
		tag = ASU
		NOT = { exists = LON }
		is_free_or_tributary_trigger = yes
		owns = 208
		owns = 207
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 12
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_leon_1_a
		ai_chance = { factor = 100 }
		set_capital = 208
		change_tag = LON
	}
	option = {
		name = kar_leon_1_b
		ai_chance = { factor = 0 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
}

# Portugal crowns itself: Portucale holding Porto and Lisboa takes the
# quinas (whatever Burtughal has done with the south, the county is done
# answering to anyone).
country_event = {
	id = kar_portugal.1
	title = kar_portugal_1_title
	desc = kar_portugal_1_desc
	picture = THRONE_ROOM_eventPicture

	trigger = {
		tag = PRT
		NOT = { exists = POR }
		is_free_or_tributary_trigger = yes
		owns = 231
		owns = 227
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 12
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_portugal_1_a
		ai_chance = { factor = 100 }
		set_capital = 227
		change_tag = POR
		hidden_effect = {
			set_government_rank = 3
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = kar_portugal_1_b
		ai_chance = { factor = 0 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
}

# Galicia breaks away: whoever holds Galicia proper lets it go under its
# own count (Hermenegildo's line is waiting in Tui with seeded cores).
country_event = {
	id = kar_galicia.1
	title = kar_galicia_1_title
	desc = kar_galicia_1_desc
	picture = THRONE_ROOM_eventPicture

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			tag = ASU
			tag = LON
		}
		NOT = { exists = GAL }
		is_free_or_tributary_trigger = yes
		owns = 206
		owns = 4554
	}

	mean_time_to_happen = {
		months = 120
	}

	option = {
		name = kar_galicia_1_a
		ai_chance = { factor = 100 }
		release = GAL
	}
	option = {
		name = kar_galicia_1_b
		ai_chance = { factor = 0 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
}
